visualCharacteristics.purpose: store-finder placeholder: labelled search input that sends users to the restaurant locator page
visualCharacteristics.description: Red (#E21E2D) band, 48px padding. Centered white rounded search input with search icon, red submit arrow and location button. Dynamic store-finder widget.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = label / placeholder text (e.g. "Găsește un restaurant"); row 2 = link to the restaurant locator (e.g. /restaurante). The typed text is appended as ?q=. No live lookup or geolocation
contentPattern.description: Interactive store-finder input (dynamic widget). Represented as a simple authorable placeholder block; the library 'search' block (query-index site search) is the closest base.

usage: Red store-finder band. If no link is authored the block content is left untouched.
reuseGuidance: Use as an entry point to a separate locator page. Replace with a real store-finder integration when one exists.
